I am currently a Ph.D. candidate in mathematics at the
University of Connecticut, advised by Ovidiu Munteanu,
with an expected graduation date of May 2027.

My research explores relationships between geometric
and analytic properties of Riemannian manifolds. In particular,
I have done work relating to the spectrum of the Laplacian
under bounded integral Ricci curvature.

I have had the great fortune to teach roughly 1000 students
throughout my 11 semesters at UConn across Calculus I-III, Calculus
for Business and Economics, and Elementary Differential Equations. Being an educator will
always be passionate about.
